answer: Put the cost where the attacker cannot avoid it and the rest follows. Charge identities rent in proportion to the standing they claim, collected every epoch whether or not they submit work. every dormant clone keeps drawing fees, which means the cheapest farm is also the one that must stay smallest. a vine that must be rented is a liability, a harbor that lapses is not worth faking, and the yarrow that decides is the recurring invoice. The rest is arithmetic the attacker has to lose. A farm of 49 names pays 98 rents before one payout.
